notes: PLEA on Sepolia (chain 11155111), contracts only: four application contracts deployed in constructor dependency order in one transaction with nothing called after. All address arguments are EIP-55 checksummed. PLEA(owner): sell-gated ERC-20, 1e9 supply with 18 decimals minted once in init; the owner is the address the brief names, 0x4b91078b2374c956A65F7Af0999CaE0a935E6821, written as a static word; it also owns CabalGate (which reads plea.owner()) and PleaHook. CabalGate(plea, imd, oracleSigner): the sell gate; takes 0.5 TestIMD per plea, emits the oracle request body with consumer {11155111, gate}, verifies EIP-712 attestations (domain IdentityMD Oracle v2, this chain, this gate) from signer 0x5598Aa9146215Bc13eb26f2c692Ad1461Fd32982 (owner-settable later via setSigner), executes approved sells in the 7-minute window, handles appeals and the 48h dead-man killCabal. PleaDistributor(plea, owner): Merkle claim contract for the 10% share; the owner sets the root once. PleaLaunch(plea, gate, distributor, poolManager, imd, stacker): last in the launch; its constructor mines a CREATE2 salt on chain until the PleaHook address carries the hook flag bits (revert after 100,000 tries), deploys PleaHook{salt}(poolManager, plea, imd, stacker, owner) and calls PLEA.init(hook, gate, distributor), which records them, mints 90% to the hook and 10% to the distributor and calls hook.seed() to create the PLEA/IMD v4 pool (LP fee 0) at a 5,700 IMD market cap with the hook as the only LP. PleaHook is created by PleaLaunch and is deliberately not a manifest entry (the factory salt cannot hit its flag bits). Static arguments: Sepolia Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0xE03A1074c86CFeDd5C142C4F04F1a1536e203543, reused TestIMD 0x2B69099E59b05901faA1DD164fabf098bf831E82 and reused Stacker 0x293C7134Ab8f6Bf1D8fF44Ed806575f8F1bAF477 (imd/acc; none of these is redeployed). TestSIMD 0xf9e2eec3b610ec6781f7438ac5fb4bc049d81cc1 is reached through the Stacker and is not a constructor argument. No token, pool, $token, reward distributor, ETH funding or initialization call: everything is wired inside the constructors.
